intro.note: Answer each question in your workbook. Show your working.
methodSteps: 1  Balance both sides like an equation
3  Flip the sign if × or ÷ by a negative
4  Write the answer as an inequality
5  Check with a value from the solution
commonMistakes: Not reversing the sign when ÷ or × by a negative.
Reversing when only adding or subtracting.
< and ≤ are not the same: ≤ includes the end value.
intro.visualAid: Number line for x < 5: an open circle at 5 (5 not included) with the line shaded to the left to show every value less than 5.

questions.content: Solve (reverse the sign when ÷ by a negative): a) −x > 3  b) −2x ≤ 8  c) 5 − x < 2
Form and solve: a) Sam has £x; after spending £12 has less than £20.  b) Taxi £4 + £2/mile, cost ≤ £20 — most whole miles?
a) Solve 4x + 3 ≥ 19; smallest integer x?  b) Solve 2x − 5 < 7; largest integer x?
Rectangle width x, length (x+4), perimeter < 36 cm, x a positive integer. a) Inequality. b) Solve. c) List possible x.
